stories.story_fr: Le capteur de glycemie FreeStyle Libre depasse desormais 2,0 Md$ de ventes trimestrielles, la franchise restant en croissance a deux chiffres sur l'ensemble de la periode.
stories.story_en: The FreeStyle Libre continuous glucose monitor franchise now exceeds $2.0 billion in quarterly sales while still posting double-digit growth.
stories.quote: continuous glucose monitors were $2.0 billion and grew 15.0 percent on a reported basis and 12.2 percent on an organic basis.

stories.story_fr: La croissance des Dispositifs Medicaux est portee par une progression a deux chiffres en Electrophysiologie, Insuffisance Cardiaque et Gestion du Rythme.
stories.story_en: Medical Devices growth is led by double-digit gains in Electrophysiology, Heart Failure and Rhythm Management.
stories.quote: Sales growth in the quarter was led by double-digit growth in Electrophysiology, Heart Failure and Rhythm Management.

stories.story_fr: Le rachat d'Exact Sciences cree un nouveau pole Diagnostic du Cancer, avec une croissance comparable de 13,4% portee par Cologuard et le test multi-cancers Cancerguard.
stories.story_en: The Exact Sciences acquisition adds a new Cancer Diagnostics vertical, with 13.4% comparable growth driven by Cologuard and the Cancerguard multi-cancer screening test.
stories.quote: Growth in Cancer Diagnostics was driven by double-digit growth of Cologuard and sales of Cancerguard, a multi-cancer screening test that launched last year.

stories.story_fr: L'essai FreeDM2 montre que les patients diabetiques de type 2 sous Libre gagnent 2,5 heures par jour dans la plage glycemique saine, renforcant l'argument clinique du capteur.
stories.story_en: The FreeDM2 trial shows Type 2 diabetes patients on FreeStyle Libre gain 2.5 more hours per day in the healthy glucose range, strengthening the device's clinical case.
stories.quote: people with Type 2 diabetes on basal insulin who used FreeStyle Libre achieved a 0.6% reduction in HbA1c and spent 2.5 more hours per day in the healthy glucose range compared to fingerstick monitoring.
